Text: IF a redemption request asks for more points than the member's redeemable balance, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the request with the member's redeemable balance in the response.
Rationale: Only posted points are redeemable (S-01); uc-redeem-voucher step 2 and 2a1.

Text: WHEN a redemption request passes the minimum and balance checks, the loyalty service shall send it to the fraud engine for scoring before issuing a voucher.
Rationale: Fraud wants to see every redemption before a voucher exists (I-01); uc-redeem-voucher step 3.

Text: WHEN the fraud engine returns no hold for a redemption, the loyalty service shall issue a single-use voucher to the member.
Rationale: Vouchers are single-use and issued only after scoring (I-01); uc-redeem-voucher step 5.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service issues a voucher, the loyalty service shall deduct the redeemed points from the member's redeemable balance.
Rationale: The voucher value must match the points deducted (SH-03 interest); uc-redeem-voucher step 5.

Text: WHEN the POS requests validation of a voucher in state Issued, the loyalty service shall return the voucher value to the POS.
Rationale: The POS checks the voucher with the loyalty service before the discount (I-01); uc-redeem-voucher step 8.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service returns a voucher value to the POS, the loyalty service shall set the voucher to Applied.
Rationale: A voucher can be used once (I-01); uc-redeem-voucher step 8. Void-sale behavior is open question Q6.

Text: IF the fraud engine places a hold on a redemption, THEN the loyalty service shall leave the member's points balance unchanged without issuing a voucher.
Rationale: Minimal guarantee of uc-redeem-voucher: points change only when a voucher is issued; extension 4a1.

Text: IF the POS requests validation of a voucher that is not in state Issued or whose code is unknown, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the validation with the reason.
Rationale: A voucher can be used once (I-01); uc-redeem-voucher extension 8a1.
